findings.issue: [WAS r1 BLOCKING — CLOSED in r2; severity now nit as resolved/historical] The r1 tier discriminant checked only the pinned/resolved binding's tier, so on a mixed-tier process (draft + published bindings sharing ONE form_binding row keyed (tenant, process_key, form_key) with no app dimension) a valid draft pin PASSED and mutated the layout the published app renders live — the mini-ADR's 'draft-only / published untouched' claim was false and untested (all-draft fixtures). Proven live by the judge's adversarial probe (version 1->2). RESOLUTION (r2, re-verified live by the judge): a nonDraft = candidates.filter(tier !== 'draft') aggregate check runs FIRST — ANY co-bound published OR NULL-tier (unverifiable) application forbids the write EVEN on a valid draft pin; applyFormDocumentOp is not called; the refusal names the offending applications. New invariant: the tool mutates form_binding only when EVERY binding of the process is tier='draft'. Judge re-verify: (a) independent external probe — mixed draft+published draft-pin -> REFUSED, version unchanged (leak closed); NULL-tier orphan co-binding -> REFUSED (fail-closed for unknown); (b) mutation — neutralizing the nonDraft gate turns AC-m1 RED with the exact r1 scenario ('got success (the r1 hole)'), gate is load-bearing; (c) AC-c (all-draft multi, no pin) still -> AMBIGUOUS_APPLICATION, so honest ASK for legitimate all-draft ambiguity is preserved (nonDraft-first does not clobber it). spec §3.1 honestly retracts r1; deviations_from_adr filled; tool schema/prompt now state 'all bindings must be drafts'.

The LLM link is still not lived end-to-end (live_proof_plan: 'NOT YET EXECUTED — непрожитым остаётся ТОЛЬКО LLM-звено'): the model actually invoking apply_form_document_op at the right moment and honestly ASKING on all-draft ambiguity is unproven. Server mechanics (schema, PURE op-validation, mixed-tier fail-close, role gate, ASK report, applyFormDocumentOp reuse) are genuinely proven via unit + live-PG. Not blocking — live-proof was not a listed T-0743 gate and the stand was offline this wave — but under D-064 the tool's product promise remains unproven until the LLM link runs.
